questions.passage: The Wealth of Nations was published in 1776, the year the U.S. declared independence. At that time, the U.S. was largely an agricultural society without any factories. In 1908, Henry Ford started producing the popular Model T. At first, his factory was able to produce only a few models a day. However, after Ford introduced the assembly line—a far more efficient division of labor—in 1913, his factory was eventually able to produce over 10,000 per day.
questions.prompt: Which year is paired with publication of The Wealth of Nations in the passage?
questions.promptZh: 片段把The Wealth of Nations出版对应哪一年？
options: The 1990 s.
analyses: A 1908是后面ModelT开始生产年份。
B 1913是后面流水线引入年份。
C was published in1776明确出版时间，并与美国宣布独立同年联系。
D 家务分工下一节才提1990年代，不可混作出版年。

vocabulary.context: 书籍问世的被动式，不等于作者出生或新版导言年份。
vocabulary.example: The volume was published several years after the letters were written.

questions.prompt: How does the book portray the United States at the earlier point in this comparison?
questions.promptZh: 在这组比较较早时点，书中如何概述美国？
options: As largely agricultural, in contrast with the later factory-production example.
As already producing over 10,000 ModelTs daily in 1776.
As a society organised entirely around large research teams.
As having introduced Ford's 1913 assembly line before the book was published.
optionsZh: 以农业为主，与后面工厂生产例子对照。
1776年已日产逾一万辆ModelT。
完全围绕大科研团队组织的社会。
在该书出版前就引入Ford1913年流水线。
analyses: A largely agricultural society是原书概述，用于历史阶段对照；不冒称另行完整历史核验。
B 将后来的工厂产量移到1776。
C 混入后面现代学术分工。
D 把出版与流水线的先后颠倒；原书without any factories措辞保留，不擅改英文或扩成独立历史证明。

vocabulary.context: 修饰agricultural，不应轻率替成所有活动全无例外相同。
vocabulary.example: The region was largely rural in the period described.

questions.prompt: Which description matches ModelT production before the assembly-line change?
questions.promptZh: 引入流水线之前，ModelT生产情况哪项符合原文？
options: The factory already exceeded 10,000 cars per day from the first day.
The book says ModelT production began only after 1913.
The factory was making pins rather than vehicles in 1908.
Production began in 1908, with only a few models made per day at first.
optionsZh: 工厂第一天就日产逾一万辆。
书中说ModelT到1913后才开产。
1908年工厂造针而非车辆。

B began1908，不能与1913改进同年。
C pinfactory为前例，Ford这里是ModelT。
D 当前候选ID包含1908开产及At first少量两句，题目覆盖两项，不把它当最终人工单句。
